definitions.explanation: The prevailing feeling or mood of a place.

examples.japanese: {気|き}が{合|あ}う{友達|ともだち}がいると{楽|たの}しい。
examples.english: It's fun when you have friends you get along with.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{気|き}を{使|つか}いすぎて、いつも{疲|つか}れている。
examples.english: He worries too much about others and is always tired.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しくて{気|き}が{休|やす}まる{時間|じかん}がないので、{週末|しゅうまつ}はゆっくり{休|やす}みたい。
examples.english: I'm so busy that I have no time to relax, so I want to take it easy on the weekend.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}か{変|へん}な{気|き}がする。
{前|まえ}にどこかで{会|あ}った{気|き}がするけど、{思|おも}い{出|だ}せない。
examples.english: I feel like we've met somewhere before, but I can't remember.

examples.japanese: {疲|つか}れすぎて{何|なに}も{食|た}べる{気|き}になれなかった。
examples.english: I was so tired that I couldn't bring myself to eat anything.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}に{負|ま}けてから{気|き}が{落|お}ちていたが、{友達|ともだち}の{言葉|ことば}で{元気|げんき}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: I was feeling down after losing the match, but my friend's words cheered me up.

examples.japanese: この{場所|ばしょ}は{気|き}がいい。
examples.english: This place has a nice atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {不思議|ふしぎ}な{気|き}が{漂|ただよ}っている。
examples.english: A mysterious air hangs over the place.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{神社|じんじゃ}に{入|はい}ると、{神聖|しんせい}な{気|き}が{感|かん}じられる。
examples.english: When you enter an old shrine, you can feel a sacred atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{頂上|ちょうじょう}は{気|き}が{澄|す}んでいて、とても{気持|きも}ちがいい。
examples.english: The air at the mountain peak is clear and very refreshing.

examples.japanese: この{森|もり}は{特別|とくべつ}な{気|き}に{満|み}ちていて、{歩|ある}いているだけで{心|こころ}が{落|お}ち{着|つ}く。
examples.english: This forest is filled with a special atmosphere, and just walking through it calms the mind.

notes:
{気|き} is used in many expressions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {気|き}をつける: to be careful
- {気|き}になる: to be concerned about
- {気|き}がする: to have a feeling
- {気|き}が{合|あ}う: to get along well
- {気|き}を{使|つか}う: to be considerate

COMPOUNDS:
- {元気|げんき}: energy, health
- {天気|てんき}: weather
- {気持|きも}ち: feeling
